title: equilibrium
intro: Find equilibrium between two soil chemicals.

sections.name: Langmuir
sections.text:
A = (my max B) / (K + B)
  < Langmuir (K K )
               (my max my max ) >

    K : number component (see chapter 59)
     Half saturation constant [g/cm3 ].

    my max : number component (see chapter 59)
     Max equilibrium capacity [g/cm3 ].

sections.name: goal A
sections.desc: Attempt to maintain A at at fixed level.
sections.sig:
< goal A (goal A goal A )
             (A solute A solute )
             (min B min B )
             (B solute B solute )
             (debug cell -1) >

attrs.name: A solute
attrs.doc:
True iff ’goal A’ is in solute (mass per volume water). If false, the unit is
     assumed to be mass per volume space.

attrs.name: min B
attrs.doc: Do not convert B to A if B is smaller than this [g/cm3 ].

attrs.name: B solute
attrs.doc:
True iff ’min B’ is in solute (mass per volume water). If false, the unit is
     assumed to be mass per volume space.

attrs.name: debug cell
attrs.doc:
Print debug information for this cell. Set it to a negative number to disable
        it.

sections.text:
Attempt to maintain A at at fixed level.
  < goal A (goal A goal A )
             (A solute A solute )
             (min B min B )
             (B solute B solute )
             (debug cell -1) >

    goal A: number component (see chapter 59)
     The desired level of A [g/cm3 ].

    A solute: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter
     True iff ’goal A’ is in solute (mass per volume water). If false, the unit is
     assumed to be mass per volume space.

    min B : number component (see chapter 59)
     Do not convert B to A if B is smaller than this [g/cm3 ].

    B solute: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter
     True iff ’min B’ is in solute (mass per volume water). If false, the unit is
     assumed to be mass per volume space.

       debug cell : integer
        Parameter (default -1)
        Print debug information for this cell. Set it to a negative number to disable
        it.

sections.name: linear
sections.text:
A=KB
 < linear         (K K ) >

       K : number component (see chapter 59)
        The ratio A/B at equilibrium [].
